answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 1220 Country: India Title: Kindly, tell me about the significance of praying 40 namaz in masjid-e-nabavi. Question: Kindly, tell me about the significance of praying 40 namaz in masjid-e-nabavi. Answer ID: 1220 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 432/430=M) According to a Hadith of Ibn Majah, the reward of one salah in Prophet?s mosque in Medina is equal to fifty thousand salah in any other mosque: صلاۃ فی مسجدی بخمسین ألف صلاۃ Apart from this, praying forty salah continuously in Masjid-un-Nabi ( Prophet?s mosque) has virtues that this will be a source of salvation from punishment and hellfire and deliverance from Nifaq ((hypocrisy). من صلی فی مسجدی اربعین صلاۃ لاتفوتہ صلاۃ کتب لہ براءۃ من النار و براءۃ من العذاب و براءۃ من النفاق۔ (مسند أحمد) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
